title: voice-pool.json
description: The voices available for each species, tagged by gender so a character can be cast from the right half of the pool. Renderer-only content, outside contentRevision for the same reason the audio set is. A voice enters the pool by being added here — not by a character happening to use it, which made a voice invisible until it was already assigned to someone.

gender.description: How the voice reads, not a claim about any character. A character of any gender may be cast from any part of the pool; this exists so the pool can be filtered while casting rather than auditioned from scratch each time.
